I've already won!
You can't stop me!
My other selves are taking over the world as we speak!
The human race is doomed!
Hahahaha!
wave starting
Great!\255\003Now we can turn off the machine and prevent all this tentacle mayhem from ever happening.
Well, I'm certainly glad THAT'S over with.
Yeah, let's get out of here.
Leaving so soon?\255\003We haven't had the chance to get to KNOW one another.
Let's discuss your hatred of humans further.
Just what is it you have against humans, anyway?
Why don't you zap FRED with the ray gun for a change?
You're pretty handy with that ray gun.
Are you SURE you're a future version of Purple Tentacle?
Are you REALLY a future version of Purple Tentacle?
We've gotta go save the world now.
What's to talk about?\255\003I detest the whole cackling, hand-wringing lot of you.

Humans are our oppressors!\255\003They made us live in this horrible motel!\255\003They created us in ungainly forms so we could not rise against them!\255\003Try walking around with your legs tied together and glue on your shoes, you'll see what I mean.
Center of the forehead, every time.
Who else would be brilliant enough to invent the Diminuator?
I said I was, did I not?
HAHAHAHAHA!!
Would you like a demonstration?
No, thanks, we can't afford it.
I bet you couldn't hit your OWN forehead.
Why don't you zap Dr. Fred if you hate him so much?
It's free of charge, unlike the Diminuator.
Nice try.
Hmmm.\255\003Perhaps that WOULD be entertaining!
So?
But humans created the Sludge-O-Matic, which made \254\008     you super-intelligent.
Sounds like you just hate Dr. Fred.
I see your point.
But humans also created the Sludge-O-Matic, which made \254\008     you super-intelligent.
Sounds like that's all Dr. Fred's fault, really.
You wouldn't understand.
Soon, the rest of the world will, too.
Nonsense.\255\003I created that myself and sent it back through time.\255\003I knew Fred's mad scientist ego would make him use it.\255\003How's that for a paradox?
It makes my heads hurt.
Who, Fred?  But there's only one of him.
Right.\255\003Anyway, you can see why I detest humans.
Hmmm.\255\003I suppose you're right about that.\255\003I didn't start out hating ALL humans, just Dr. Fred.
Could you give us some stock tips?
Do the Sharks ever have a winning season?
Do we manage to defeat you and save the world?
Can you remember stuff that hasn't happened yet?
Are you MORE or LESS intelligent than the Purple \254\008     Tentacle from our time?
How is it that you can grow hair without follicles?
I think we'd best be off now.
Naturally.
The same, but I'VE had two hundred years to think things over.\255\003Heh heh heh heh.
It wasn't easy^\255\003^but the secret made me VERY wealthy.
If you wish.\255\003You won't want to miss the enslavement of everyone on Earth.
Don't invest in shoes!\255\003HAHAHAHAHA!
No, but the Tentacles do!\255\003HAHAHAHAHA!
Of course not!
Bummer.
Excuse us^
Look, we're not letting you touch that lever.
I said we're not letting you touch the lever.
Could you let us pull that lever over there?
Would you mind hopping out to get us some Chinese food?
Look behind you, a three-headed monkey!
Which one of you is the real Purple Tentacle?
Nice try, but we're not budging.
The only three-headed monkey here is in FRONT of us.
We all are, dopey.\255\003Weren't you paying attention earlier?
Now, buzz off.
Oh, drat!
Ummm^\255\003^surely we can talk this out.
Talk^
Surely^
WAIT!
You haven't heard the last of me!\255\003I'll be back!  And the next time^\255\003^the world^\255\003^and all its piffling inhabitants^\255\003^shall be MINE!\255\003All MINE!
All mine!
OK, little fella.\255\003Mail this to Siberia.
Our work here is done.
Now we can go home.
Maybe I put them upstairs^\255\003^that's got to be it!  Upstairs!
Mmmm. Thanks.\255\003I needed a little pick-me-up.
Must ^ open ^ safe ^
Must ^ sign ^ contract ^\255\003Must ^ provide ^ for ^ family ^
Now THAT'S good coffee!
Damn good coffee!
He's already unconscious; decaf might kill him!
But it's worth a try.
It looks like he has plenty of coffee already.
I've got the plans!
Quick!  We have to flush them to Hoagie!
How'd you get over there?
My ingenious super-battery design, please.
You really flushed them!
Yes!!!
Down the toilet!
No!\255\003Through TIME!
Using the highly sophisticated Time-Flux Hydraulic Vortex Chamber I've installed in each Chron-O-John^\255\003You can flush small, inanimate objects to each other through time!
^flush small, inanimate objects to each other through time!
Hello!
Dr. Fred?\255\003Can you hear me?
Drat.
Did you hear something?
No.\255\003Let's see if What's-his-name catches on.
Oh, great.\255\003I'm stuck in colonial times, tentacles are taking over the world, and now the toilet's backing up.
Hoagie^
^come over here^
It's your old pal Doctor Fred.
Doctor Fred?  How'd you get in there?
I want you to pick up those plans you see in the Chron-O-John, Hoagie.
Bring them to RED Edison.\255\003He's my great, great, great, great^\255\003^great, great, great^
^great, great, great grandfather.\255\003He'll know what to do.
You need the plans to make a super-battery, so you can plug in your Chron-O-John!
Okay, if you say so, Bernard.
Good boy.
Does he have any experience with electronics?
Uh^ I once saw him take three-thousand volts directly through his head without batting an eye.
Didn't he pass out?
Well, he was already passed out when it happened.
Time for me to save the world, I guess.
So, as soon as Hoagie gets that battery working, we're set!
